transcription: Good morning, you are through to the broadband support team. My name is Sarah. How can I help? Hi Sarah. My internet keeps dropping out every evening, usually around seven o'clock. I am sorry to hear that. Can you tell me which lights are showing on your router right now? The power light is green, but the internet light is flashing orange. Thanks. That usually means the line is out of sync. I will run a quick test from our side. Okay, no problem. The test found some noise on the line. I can book an engineer for Thursday morning. Does that work for you? Thursday morning is perfect. Thank you very much.
